arguments.content:
Starting storage: {{int:96:144}} TB
Monthly growth rate: 4% (0.04)
Target storage: {{int:160:240}} TB

We need the smallest integer n such that:
    {{int:96:144}} * (1 + 0.04)^n > {{int:160:240}}

Solve for n (continuous):
    (1.04)^n > {{int:160:240}} / {{int:96:144}}
    (1.04)^n > 1.6666667
    n > log(1.6666667) / log(1.04)

Using natural logarithms:
    ln(1.6666667) ≈ 0.510826
    ln(1.04) ≈ 0.039221
    n > 0.510826 / 0.039221 ≈ 13.02

Since n must be an integer number of months, we round up:
    n = {{int:11:17}} months

Therefore, after **{{int:11:17}} months** the storage will exceed {{int:160:240}} TB.
